notes.title: Puzzling Wild IQ Test Out Now
notes.content:
This one's for all the brain-boxes out there.

If you'd like to train your brain on some intelligence puzzles this is for you.

Hosted by Ginger and Hugo, who have now got into the podcasting scene.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078070/Puzzling_Wild_IQ_Test/

Popular in Japan. 😀

notes.title: Coming Soon: Puzzling Wild IQ Test
notes.content:
Do you like to test your brain? 

Out by end of year (2022):

[h1]Puzzling Wild IQ Test[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078070/Puzzling_Wild_IQ_Test/

Your favourite characters Ginger T Giraffe, and Hugo T Hippo, present 400 logic puzzles to test how clever you are. Each puzzle has no instructions, you just use your logic and reasoning to paint in the answer. The game collects everyone's score and uses it to estimate your IQ using math™. 

Add it to your wish list if it's your sort of thing.

More info to come shortly...

notes.title: Haunted House of Doom - Out now!
notes.content:
Paul Bird has released a new game called "[b]The Haunted House of Doom[/b]" just in time for Halloween!

The game is a puzzle game where you have to collect objects to solve the puzzles in the house and solve the mystery of [b]The Haunted House of Doom[/b].

Solve the mystery at your own pace. But, there is a horror theme so, the game has a bit of a bite! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781920/The_Haunted_House_of_Doom/

The game is having positive reviews so far. If you like this sort of game, why not give it a go?

If you like old style adventure games this game might be for you. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: "The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe" out this week!
notes.content:
"The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe" game is a prequel to Wild Animal Racing and tells the story of how an ordinary talking giraffe by the name of Ginger was given magical shrinking powers in order to save the Universe from evil snake spirits. 

Using his power of shrinking, Ginger must kill all the snake spirits and send them back to the quantum realm. 

The game is due to be released this week so add it to your wishlist if you wish to be notified when it comes out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1033220/The_Amazing_Shrinking_Giraffe

notes.title: Online multiplayer update
notes.content:
Update (18 April): I am creating a new server. Should be up and running in the next couple of days.

Technical stuff below...

In the forthcoming update, I've made some changes to the online multiplayer mode as it was not working for some people. I've disabled the "facilitator" as a default which was causing problems which just means that it should work if you have a direct connection to the internet. 

Also, I've added some instructions if anyone wants to attempt to set up their own server. (This is mainly for experts!) There is an instruction file if you go to the "browse local files" in Steam. 

I have made these changes to the Windows files. If everything is fine I'll then update the Mac files.

Let me know if this works or doesn't for you. :spelunky:

notes.title: Bundles of joy!
notes.content:
This is to announce the creation of the first Marjupi Games bundle. This includes [b]Wild Animal Racing[/b] and [b]Alien Insanity[/b]. But don't worry if you already have one of these games, it means you can get the other one at a discount!

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3418/Marjupi_Games_Bundle/

A little introduction to [b]Alien Insanity[/b]...

While Wild Animal Racing is very character based, Alien Insanity is all about the challenging puzzles. Although it is an arcade game it very much requires a deep level of thought. An expert gamer may be able to complete all 24 hand crafted levels in under 4 hours but most for most mere mortals it may require several days or weeks.

If you manage to complete all 24 levels (and its no easy task only 10% have got this far), it is possible to create your own levels with the inbuilt level editor. Modify the textures and even upload your level to the workshop for others to play.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/598350/Alien_Insanity/

notes.title: Merry Christmas!!!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Christmas[/b] one and all! Hope you're stuffing your stocking in the Winter Sale! I'm not entirely sure how many people around the world celebrate Christmas, but I think there's some kind of winter festival in most places. In England, where I live we have Father Christmas who brings everybody presents. It hasn't snowed yet but it hardly ever does anyway. 

The animals in Wild Animal Racing have a celebration this time of year although they're not entirely sure why. They saw people on television doing it and it looked fun. Henrietta the Hippo was given the job of the Jolly Fat Person In The Red Hat. She wasn't the best choice. She's no good at being jolly. Her main look is "intense". They didn't have any reindeer so the Ginger the Giraffe got a few of his friends together and they stuck some branches on their heads. They haven't got it quite right but they tried, and thats the main thing!

Hopefully I'll be bringing you a new Christmas animation here so stay tuned. Merry Winterval to you all. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9940578/4501a6bb9346dda61112b5511f3f75b48df3c73e.png[/img]

Henrietta Hippo looking intense.

notes.title: Three Day Sale!! Don't miss out!
notes.content:
If you missed out on getting a new microwave for a pound during the Black Friday sales. Don't be sad. Because now you can get Wild Animal Racing for a discount in this three day sale! What's more you don't have to get trampled by hoards of eager bargain hunters to take advantage of this offer. 

Wild Animal Racing is much like what Black Friday would be like if instead of human shoppers running for a bargain, the humans were large animals and instead of running they were driving cars, and instead of running towards a cheap toaster they were driving towards a finish line. 

Perhaps the shoppers on Black Friday could take some tips from Wild Animal Racing. Maybe dropping a few tactical banana skins to thwart other shoppers. Or wearing spiking shoes! Or encasing themselves in giant bubbles.

You see Wild Animal Racing is not just a game. It teaches you life lessons.

Have fun.

Still time to get Wild Animal Racing in the sale for 25% off. If you were thinking of buying another game like NMS for example, why not save your money and buy Wild Animal Racing 17 times? Then with the change you can buy yourself a nice hot cup of cocoa. OK, that would be silly.

This message is to anyone whose been waiting for [b]Wild Animal Racing[/b] to be at its lowest price before buying... well this is it! Its not getting any cheaper than this, this year! ːsteamhappyː So if you've been waiting now's your chance. You have until Independence Day (4th July) so no rush. 

Also if you've been playing W.A.R. solo, now is a good time to get your friends (or enemies) to join in and give them a damn good thrashing using your accumulated W.A.R skills!

To everyone who bought W.A.R previously can I say 'thank you' as well. You made it what it is today: the best darn wild animal racing game there is. Ginger the Giraffe salutes you.

Race well my friends.

notes.title: Even More Fun at a New Lower Price!
notes.content:
[b]Wild Animal Racing[/b] has been a phenomenal success! With many creative YouTube reviews in the last two months with hundreds of thousands of views in several languages. There have even been several fan clubs associated with it! The character of Ginger the Giraffe has been particularly popular with his enigmatic look mesmerising players!

In this updated version of [b]Wild Animal Racing....[/b]

By popular demand the collectables now respawn for better multiplayer balancing! This means that you can collect more weapons which means the game now has more of a competitive edge! 

We have also made many smaller improvements from the first release.

A new [b]lower price[/b] is being tried so take advantage of it today! We hope that with this new lower price we will bring in even more players! 

[b]Wild Animal Racing[/b] is fun to play on your own to win races and collect points to unlock the animated videos. It is also lots of fun to play in split screen mode with a friend! 

Happy racing! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Improved multiplayer networking
notes.content: The networking in [b]Wild Animal Racing[/b] has been streamlined to allow it to play better over lower quality broadband. This should help give smoother game play in multiplayer mode. All players will need to update to the latest version to take advantage of this. We shall continue to review this to make sure all players have the best experience.
